title: Template
description: A document template schema for PDF Generator API

id.description: Template unique identifier. Generated by the service

anyOf.description: A list of tags that describe the template
A comma separated list of tags that describe the template

isDraft.description: Specifies if the template is a draft

layout.description: Describes template layout properties like width, height, format and margins

anyOf.description: Specifies page size if layout is repeated on the page e.g sheet labels
To allow legacy templates pass the validation

emptyLabels.description: Specifies how many pages or labels should be empty

pages.description: A list of pages in template

width.description: Page width in units. Defaults to template width if not defined.

height.description: Page height in units.  Defaults to template height if not defined.

top.description: Page or label margin from top. Defaults to 0 if not defined.

right.description: Page or label margin from right. Defaults to 0 if not defined.

bottom.description: Page or label margin from bottom. Defaults to 0 if not defined.

left.description: Page or label margin from left. Defaults to 0 if not defined.

anyOf.description: This is added to support legacy templates where empty object is converted to empty array
Describes template layout properties like width, height, format and margins

components.description: A list of components on page

dataSettings.description: Specifies filter and sort option for root data set.

heightMultiplier.description: Specifies the height multiplier for page in the editor view.

anyOf.description: Specifies if font-subsetting is applied when PDF is rendered.
Added to support legacy template validation
Specifies if aa barcodes are rendered as images (PNG) instead of vector graphic.
Added to support legacy template validation

textColumns.description: Allows to split content into number of even columns.

decimalSeparator.description: Specifies decimal separator used to format number values.

decimalPlaces.description: Specifies how many decimal places are shown.

thousandsSeparator.description: Specifies thousands separator used to format number values.

autoIncreaseStep.description: Specifies auto increment value when iterated in container component.

formatter.description: Describes component formatting. In legacy templates number formatting options can also be in the component root level. In new templates all formatting options are in the formatter object.

input.description: Specifies input format based on momentjs specification.

output.description: Specifies output format based on momentjs specification.

filterBy.description: Specifies a list of filtering rules.

dataIndex.description: Specifies data field that is used in comparison

search.description: Specifies value that is compared to data field or the expression.

groupBy.description: Specifies a list data fields that are used for grouping.

dataIndex.description: Specifies the data field used for grouping

sortBy.description: Specifies a list of sorting rules.

dataIndex.description: Specifies the data field used for sorting

conditionalFormats.description: Specifies a list of conditional formatting rules.

format.description: Specifies component style that is applied if rule matches condition. Allows all font related properties

condition.description: Specifies condition when rule is applied

dataIndex.description: Specifies data field that is used in comparison

search.description: Specifies value that is compared to data field or the expression.

top.description: Specifies if component has top border visible.

right.description: Specifies if component has right border visible.

bottom.description: Specifies if component has left border visible.

left.description: Specifies if component has bottom border visible.

top.description: Specifies component position from page top in units.

left.description: Specifies component position from page top in units.

margins.description: Page margins in units. Missing sides default to 0.

zindex.description: Specifies z-index (layer index) for the component.

borderColor.description: Specifies border color in hex color code.

backgroundColor.description: Specifies background color in hex color code.

dataIndex.description: Specifies data field that is used to iterate table rows.

value.description: Specifies component value, it can be plain text, data field placeholder, HTML or expression.

useFlexHeight.description: Specifies if content should be cut to fit into component width and height.

isEditable.description: Specifies if component is rendered as editable PDF field.

isPlainHTML.description: Specifies if HTML is rendered as plain text in PDF.

compactHtmlRendering.description: Removes auto-generated paragraph margins in HTML content to reduce gaps between components.

dynamicFontSize.description: Specifies if component font size is reduced until content fits into component width and height.

anyOf.description: Specifies component font size in pixels.
Added to support legacy template validation

fontColor.description: Specifies font color in hex color code.

lineHeight.description: Specifies component line height relative to font size. E.g. 1.15 = 115% of font size.

textDirection.description: Specifies component text direction - left to right or right to left.

padding.description: Specifies component internal padding in units.

top.description: Specifies component top padding in units.

right.description: Specifies component right padding in units.

bottom.description: Specifies component bottom padding in units.

left.description: Specifies component left padding in units.

rows.description: Specifies a list of table rows. Rows that are not header or static are repeated for each item in the data field.

isHeader.description: Specifies if the row is header.

isStatic.description: Specifies if the row is static and should not be repeated for each item in the dataset.

isDynamic.description: Specifies if the table creates columns for each unique key in data field row.

hideHeaderIfEmpty.description: Specifies if table header is hidden if there are no rows to repeat.

iterateLeftToRight.description: Specifies rendering direction. Defaults to top to bottom

autoShrink.description: Specifies if component height is reduced based on the inner sub-component height.

headerOrFooterComponent.description: Specifies header and footer component properties.

autoScale.description: Specifies if we should auto scale image to match original width-height ratio.

autoRotate.description: Specifies if we should auto rotate image based on image meta-data.

showText.description: Specifies if the value is displayed under the barcode.

quietZone.description: Specifies if quiet zone is added around the barcode.

scaleText.description: Specifies if the barcode value should be scaled based on barcode size.

yAxisDataIndex.description: Specifies a list of y-axis fields

pieLabel.description: Specifies a pie chart label configuration

items.description: Specifies what is shown as label.
